crop.notes: Whole 'The Ring' item about Niel and the Dalys, column 2, across two pieces.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Tom Allen said "Dutch" Niel exaggerated: Allen had offered $50 toward a purse for a Niel-Johnnie Daly fight, not a $500 side bet.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, November 12, 1892, page 8.

facts.fact: Allen denied he would put up a $500 side bet for "Dutch" Niel against Johnnie Daly, saying he had offered only $50 toward a purse
facts.quote: I told him that I would give $50 towards a purse for such a contest, but he certainly had no grounds for putting me down as saying I would furnish a $500 side bet for him. I would like to see "Dutch" and Johnnie brought together, but I am not prepared to wager $500 on the result.
